records.title: 10-Q

records.text: Our Propulsion segment delivered lower sales and operating earnings versus a record first quarter of 2023, as boat manufacturers and dealers moderated orders and managed production of current model-year products and pipelines ahead of the retail season and model-year change-over.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our international net sales decreased 19 percent in the first quarter on a GAAP and constant currency basis when compared to the prior year quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Partially offsetting these increases was a decline in Industrial's twelve-month backlog due to lower orders across our industrial automation and our medical device programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 1Q 2024
records.text: Consolidated revenue increased 8% in the first quarter of 2024 and organic revenue decreased 3% largely due to weaker demand for our capital equipment products at our Material Handling segment, partially offset by stronger demand at our Industrial Processing segment.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 1Q 2024
records.text: Our consolidated bookings decreased 10% to $248.4 million in the first quarter of 2024 compared to unprecedented record bookings in the first quarter of 2023, but increased 14% compared to the fourth quarter of 2023, including an 11% increase from acquisitions and strong demand for our parts and consumables products across all segments.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 1Q 2024
records.text: •Flow Control – Our Flow Control segment bookings increased 11% sequentially compared to the fourth quarter of 2023.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 1Q 2024
records.text: Consolidated gross profit margin increased to 44.6% in the first quarter of 2024 compared with 44.4% in the first quarter of 2023 due to a larger proportion of higher-margin parts and consumables revenue and higher margins achieved on our capital equipment products especially at our Flow Control segment.

records.title: KAI FORM 10Q 1Q 2024
records.text: Net income decreased to $25.0 million in the first quarter of 2024 from $28.3 million in the first quarter of 2023 primarily due to a $3.2 million decrease in operating income and a $2.3 million increase in interest expense, offset in part by a $1.9 million decrease in provision for income taxes (see discussions above for further details).

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2024 increased 2.9% to $3.39 billion from $3.30 billion for the first quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.text: The increase in net sales was driven by contributions from new store openings and growth in comparable store sales.

records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold weather selling season.

records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the first quarter of fiscal 2024 increased 50 basis points to 36.0% from 35.5% in the first quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.text: Operating income for the first quarter of fiscal 2024 increased 7.6% to $263.1 million from $244.4 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2023.
